en.title: Chiwei Mountain - Hanyuan B&B | ChiShan's #1 Peak, Taiwan's 65th Xiao-Bai-Yue, Twin-Summit Challenge
en.description: At 380 m above sea level, Chiwei Mountain is the iconic landmark of ChiShan District, Kaohsiung, and the 65th entry on Taiwan's Xiao-Bai-Yue list. Named for its ancient-flag silhouette, the trail offers both east- and west-summit challenges, with sweeping views of ChiShan town, the Nanzi River valley and the Gaoping Plain.
